title: On Conveying the order in a single line
subtitle: 人际沟通 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）
meta: 主题语境：人际沟通（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·人际沟通与交流）　|　核心词汇：convey　|　正文 353 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 convey 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1970 the director ① conveyed the order in a single line in silence, and every actor in the theatre said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three nights on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the director ② conveys the order in a single line twice over without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ convey the order in a single line at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ conveyed the order in a single line before — a line in the poster for August 1964 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Conveying the order in a single line in silence, the director said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the script at the far stage, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ convey the sand up from the beach twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Convey the sand up from the beach at once and never mention it again.

By 1977 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the poster, and a new actor from the next theatre ⑧ conveys the sand up from the beach in silence every night without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the stage, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ conveyed the order in a single line again when nobody else would.

⑩ To convey the order in a single line, my mother said in 1982, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the theatre remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the theatre forgets, somebody conveys the order in a single line twice over again and somebody must convey the order in a single line in silence all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 传达（一般过去式 conveyed the order in a single line：1970 年导演头一回这样做，一言不发地）
B. v. 传达（一般现在 conveys the order in a single line：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 传达（不定式 to convey the order in a single line：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 传达（过去完成时 had conveyed the order in a single line：1964 年八月的戏报上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 传达（动名词 conveying the order in a single line 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 运送（convey the sand up from the beach：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去运送把沙从滩上运来）
G. v. 运送（convey the sand up from the beach：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 传达（后段两处：新来的演员照例 conveys the sand up from the beach，而母亲又一次 conveyed the order in a single line）

answers.why: convey 意为“传达”，1970 年导演一言不发地传达一句话把命令传达下来，那是戏院里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 conveyed。
convey 意为“传达”，自那以后导演来回两遍把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 conveys。
convey 意为“传达”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯传达一句话把命令传达下来”，此处为不定式 to convey the order in a single line。
convey 意为“传达”，戏报里 八月 那行字说明早在 1977 年之前就有人传达过，故用过去完成时 had conveyed。
convey 意为“传达”，导演说“传达一句话把命令传达下来这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 conveying the order in a single line 作主语。
convey 意为“运送”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去运送把沙从滩上运来”，should ever 之后用原形 convey the sand up from the beach。
convey 意为“运送”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻运送把沙从滩上运来（convey the sand up from the beach at once），以后再也不要提起。
convey 意为“传达”，新来的演员每个夜晚都照例运送把沙从滩上运来，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 conveys。
convey 意为“传达”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次一言不发地传达一句话把命令传达下来，用一般过去式 conveyed 叙述。
convey 意为“传达”，结尾那句是母亲 1982 年的话：要传达一句话把命令传达下来，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和戏院记住的那一件。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1970 年，导演一言不发地传达一句话把命令传达下来；戏院里每一个演员都说这是头一回。（conveyed the order in a single line）
多年以后，导演仍来回两遍做着同一件事，不必有人开口。（conveys the order in a single line）
母亲后来说，难就难在肯传达一句话把命令传达下来这件事本身。（to convey the order in a single line）
早在 1964 年就有人传达一句话把命令传达下来，八月那天戏报上的一行字就是证据。（had conveyed the order in a single line）
导演说过，一言不发地传达一句话把命令传达下来这件事，是九分耐心一分胆气。（conveying the order in a single line 作主语）
老手们留下的规矩说得明白：立刻运送把沙从滩上运来，以后再也不要提起。（convey the sand up from the beach，祈使句）
answers: In 1970 the director conveyed the order in a single line in silence, and every actor in the theatre said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there.
Three nights on, the director still conveys the order in a single line twice over without being asked.
My mother said later that to convey the order in a single line at all was the part nobody had expected.
Somebody had conveyed the order in a single line long before 1977, and the line in the poster for August proves it.
Conveying the order in a single line in silence, the director said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
The rule the old hands handed down was plain: Convey the sand up from the beach at once and never mention it again.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 convey 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1970 the director conveyed the order in a single line in silence, and nobody in the theatre forgot it.
Even now the director conveys the order in a single line twice over whenever the theatre asks.
Conveying the order in a single line in silence, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever convey the sand up from the beach twice over, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new actor from the next theatre conveys the sand up from the beach in silence every night, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother conveyed the order in a single line again, and the theatre remembered that half.
